title: Table field offset
statement: Given a list $h$, a list $es$ of lists of lists, and a natural number $j$, define the table offset as the field offset in the table fields at index one plus the sum of the lengths of the first $j$ entries of $es$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the field-offset function, so the resulting numerical offset cannot be described further.
